text:
lena: hey team, hitting a weird blocker on the quickstart. local node sample works but when I run the dockerized quickstart I get an error: \"Tenant not authorized\" and the app shows a generic UI error. no helpful link to billing or org settings.

samira: can you paste the exact error/response body? is it from our SDK or the gateway?

lena: pasted it — body is:
```json
{
  \"error\": \"Tenant not authorized\",
  \"code\": \"tenant_blocked\",
  \"details\": null
}
```

mike: that code is our generic catch-all for a few backend conditions. curious: does the same workspace pass the cloud quickstart (non-docker)?

lena: yes, same account, I can call the hosted API with curl from my laptop. only the containerized sample fails.

ops_jay: probable env mismatch. quickstarts sometimes rely on REDWOOD_ORG or WORKSPACE_ID being set to map requests to a tenant with billing state. in docker we mount .env differently. can you run `docker logs` and check the container env at startup?

lena: aha, the container image drops REDWOOD_ORG if you don't pass --env-file. it falls back to anonymous routing and the gateway returns tenant_blocked because the anonymous tenant requires billing contact.

devex: yikes. that's a DX hole — 1) misleading error 2) quickstart template doesn't validate env upfront. propose two quick fixes: surface a clearer SDK error if org header missing and add a startup check in quickstart that warns when envs are absent with a link to billing settings.

samira: agree. small SDK change: if we see tenant_blocked and no org header present, return error message: \"Request blocked: workspace requires billing setup. Ensure REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org is set. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<workspace-id>/billing\"

mike: also add a small container entrypoint check like:
```bash
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ORG" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ REDWOOD_ORG not set. Quickstart will route to an anonymous workspace which may be billing-locked. See ${CONSOLE_URL:-https://console.redwood.ai}/workspaces"
fi
```

ops_jay: i'll patch the quickstart repo and push a tiny PR with the startup warning + README note. samira — want to take the SDK error text change?

samira: on it. i’ll add a unit test that simulates missing org header mapping to tenant_blocked and assert the new hint text is returned.

billing-bot: Heads-up: workspace wz-9c2 requires billing contact on file. If you are the admin, visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-9c2/billing to add payment/contact info.

lena: thanks! with the env set locally the container works. reassigning to devex for follow-up on docs + PRs. 🙂

devex: thanks @lena, filing two tasks: quickstart-env-warning and sdk-tenant-block-hint. will link PRs and add a short onboarding note to the welcome email so new orgs know why firstcall might be blocked.

mike: nice triage. low-risk change, big win for first-time users. :thumbsup:
